∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] (V : Type v) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{v} V] [inst_2 : Module.{u, v} k V]
  [Module.Finite.{u, v} k V] (n : Nat) [CharZero.{u} k],
  And
    (Eq.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} (Etingof.symGroupImage.{u, v} k V n)
      (Subalgebra.centralizer.{u, max u v} k
        (SetLike.coe.{max u v, max u v} (Etingof.diagonalActionImage.{u, v} k V n))))
    (Eq.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} (Etingof.diagonalActionImage.{u, v} k V n)
      (Subalgebra.centralizer.{u, max u v} k (SetLike.coe.{max u v, max u v} (Etingof.symGroupImage.{u, v} k V n))))

∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] (V : Type v) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{v} V] [inst_2 : Module.{u, v} k V]
  [Module.Finite.{u, v} k V] (n : Nat) [CharZero.{u} k],
  And
    (IsSemisimpleRing.{max u v}
      (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v} (Etingof.symGroupImage.{u, v} k V n) x))
    (IsSemisimpleRing.{max u v}
      (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v} (Etingof.diagonalActionImage.{u, v} k V n) x))

source_text: The symmetric-group and diagonal action images are mutual centralizers, and the tensor power is semisimple for both.
